meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作按时间轴编排的可渲染视觉
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望通过代码和 HTML 亲手制作动态影像作品
copy.tagline_en: Create renderable visual scenes timed by code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to craft dynamic animations with code and HTML.

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规则构建可渲染的视频项目：用 data-* 属性标定时、内容放进模板、只建一条暂停时间线，并遵守确定性渲染和验证要求。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或修改 HyperFrames 组合 HTML，或涉及 data-* 时间属性、子组合、变量、媒体播放等话题时触发。

say.text: 给我一个最小的 HyperFrames 组合骨架。
子组合的 data-composition-id 该和什么对齐？
say.note: 会解释主机槽与内部模板的 id 必须完全相同。

say.text: 帮我把这段动画改成确定性渲染。
say.note: 会移除随机数、无限重复等不确定性写法。

howto.what_en: Claude builds a renderable HyperFrames project per the contract: data-* timing attributes, template-wrapped content, one paused timeline, determinism rules, and validation checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to write or edit HyperFrames composition HTML, or discusses data-* timing, sub-compositions, variables, media playback, Tailwind, storyboard/script plans.

say_en.text: Give me a minimal HyperFrames composition skeleton.
say_en.note: Generates basic HTML with root element and data-start.

say_en.text: What must my sub-composition's data-composition-id match?
say_en.note: Explains host slot and inner template IDs must be identical.
Removes randomness, infinite repeats, and other non-determinism.
